sentences.text: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge Order On Board 10/07/2024 1.

The petitioners have filed this writ petition seeking following reliefs:-
"10.1 That the Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to call the records of the case from the respondents for its kind consideration of the Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:24689 Hon'ble Court.
10.2.

That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue an appropriate writ,
thereby directing the respondent authorities to release the assessed compensation to the petitioners with interest as prescribed under Section 80 of the Act, 2013 from the date of taking possession to its actual payment forthwith.
10.3.

That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the respondent Land Acquisition Officer for assessment of compensation towards the land khasra No.869/3 area 0.066 hectare recorded in the name of petitioner no.1 and pay the Gesbai Ajgalley vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 10 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86224333/
1 same to the petitioner no.1 with interest as prescribed under under Section 80 of Act,
2013 from the date of taking possession to its actual payment forthwith.

sentences.text: 10.4. That any other relief/order which may deem fit and just in the facts and circumstances of the case including award of costs of the petition may be given."

2. Learned counsel for petitioners submits that petitioner No.1 is owner of the land bearing Kh.
No.869/3 and Kh.No.869/4-[k admeasuring area 0.3200 hectare and 0.3880 hectare respectively.
Petitioner No.2 is owner of land bearing kh. No.869/4-d and kh. No.869/7 area 0.3840 hectares and 0.3450 heaters respectively.
The aforesaid lands of the petitioners have been acquired for "Project-25 up-gradation and re-construction Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:24689 of Jaijaipur-Malkharoda-Gobrabhatha Road".
Land of petitioner No.1 bearing kh. no.869/4-[k has been acquired for which amount of compensation of Rs.23,43,360/- was assessed, however, the same has not been paid till date.
Land of petitioner No.1 bearing kh. no.869/3 area 0.026 hectare was also affected but while making the calculation, the same has not been taken for determination of compensation.

Similarly, compensation has been assessed for the land of the petitioner No.2 bearing kh. no. 869/4-d and 869/7, however, till date, compensation has not been released by the Land Acquisition Officer.

He submits that the land owned by the petitioners is affected in construction of road, therefore, a direction be issued to respondents No.3 & 4 to follow appropriate proceeding of acquisition and to pay the amount of compensation.

Representations have also been made by the petitioners before respondent No.3/SDO raising their respective grievances, however,
till date no decision has been taken on it.
He submits that a direction be issued to respondents No.3 & 4 to take appropriate proceeding of acquisition and to pay the amount of compensation with respect to above-stated land of the petitioners.
3. Learned State counsel do not dispute the submission of learned counsel for the petitioners with respect to submission of representation by the petitioners.

He submits that if the land of the petitioners if used in construction of Jaijaipur-Malkharoda - Gobrabhatha road and compensation has not been paid or left Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:24689 out from acquisition proceeding,
appropriate decision will be taken by the respondent authorities in accordance with law.
4. I have heard learned counsel for parties and perused the documents placed on record.

5. In the aforementioned facts of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the respective parties,
this writ petition at this stage is disposed off permitting the petitioners to submit fresh representation before respondents No. 3 & 4 raising all their grievance as raised in this writ petition.

If such representation is submitted by the petitioners, the same shall be considered and decided in accordance with law expeditiously, preferably within a period of 4 weeks from the date of receipt of order passed by this Court.
